154295499.title: File:1928 Inter-American Committee of Conciliation and Arbitration meeting on the Paraguayan-Bolivian border dispute.png

ObjectName.value: 1928 Inter-American Committee of Conciliation and Arbitration meeting on the Paraguayan-Bolivian border dispute

Categories.value: Charles Evans Hughes|Orestes Ferrara|PD US expired|Diplomatic meetings

ImageDescription.value: Original caption reads: "The saying that a few willful men around a table start the world's wars may be true sometimes, but this group is trying to end one. The picture shows the committee of Inter-American Conciliation and Arbitration which met in extraordinary session in Washington to find a peaceful means of settling the Bolivian-Paraguyan dispute. Left to right seated, are Manuel Foster, representing Chile; [Silvino] Gurgel do Amaral, Brazilian ambassador to the United States; Dr. Victor Maurtua, representing Peru; Charles Evans Hughes, former secretary of state, representing the United States; Dr. Orestes Ferrara, Cuban ambassador to the United States, Standing are: P. L. Boal, left, secretary to Mr. Hughes; and Benjamin Cohen, Interpreter and secretary to the committee."

Credit.value: "Trying to Avert War in South America," Hinton Daily News XXVI, no. 199, 27 December 1928, 3. via Newspapers.com (https://www.newspapers.com/image/667565552/).

Artist.value: Newspaper Enterprise Association

ImageDescription.value: The National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics in session at Washington to discuss plans to place America foremost in the development of aviation. A report was heard from Dr. Ames, chairman of the executive committee, on research work to develop the new heavy oil fuel injection aircraft engine which does away with carburetor and spark plugs, and will lesson the fire hazard. Dr. S.W. Stratton, secretary of the committee and director of the Bureau of Standards, is shown seated at the extreme left. Around the table, left to right, are: Prof. Charles F. Marvin, chief of the weather bureau; Dr. John F. Hayford (Northwestern Univ.); Orville Wright; Major Thurman H. Bane (chief Engineer Div. Army); Paul Henderson, (Second Ass. Postmaster Gen.); Rear Adm. W.A. Moffett, Chief Bureau Aeronautics, Navy; Dr. Michael I. Pupin, (Columbia Univ.); Rear Adm. D.W. Taylor, U.S.N. (Chief Bureau Construction and repair); Dr. Charles D. Walcott, chairman, (Chief Air Service) and Dr. Joseph S. Ames, chairman executive committee (Johns Hopkins Univ.)
